[[File:Αντώνης Σαμαράς - Συνεδρίαση Κοινοβουλευτικής Ομάδας 24-07-2012 7732412732.jpg|thumb|Photo of Athanasios Bouras]]
'''Athanasios''' ('''Thanasis''') '''Bouras''' ({{langx|el|Αθανάσιος (Θανάσης) Μπούρας}}<ref>http://www.abouras.gr/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=66&Itemid=77&lang=el {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120729111839/http://www.abouras.gr/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=66&Itemid=77&lang=el |date=29 July 2012 }} (Greek) Retrieved 17 July 2012.</ref>) is a [[Greece|Greek]] politician. He holds a Ph.D. in physics and several physics publications. He was the deputy finance minister from 1990 to 1993 and currently represents [[Attica]] in the [[Hellenic Parliament]]. He is a member of [[New Democracy (Greece)|New Democracy]].
